about_the_game:
Overview:
Immerse yourself in the world of Exilium: Kiro like never before with the Ultimate Supporter Pack. This DLC delivers the complete collection of all 42 stunning in-game CGs, meticulously remastered in breathtaking 4K Ultra HD resolution. Own every moment of the story, from the most tender to the intensely intimate, in unparalleled detail.

Description:
This pack is a must-have for dedicated fans and art lovers. We've upgraded every single background art and character illustration from the main game to crystal-clear 4K (3840x2160), allowing you to appreciate the fine details and beautiful artistry that went into creating the world. The collection includes all scenes, ensuring a complete and uncensored archive of the game's visual journey.

By purchasing this Supporter Pack, you are not only securing a high-resolution art collection but also directly supporting us, the developers, as we continue to create more content.

Key Features:

  • Complete Art Collection: Every single CG from the main game—all 42 illustrations.

  • Stunning 4K Resolution: Experience every scene in ultra-high definition (3840x2160). See every brushstroke, every detail, and every emotion like never before.

  • Uncensored & Unedited: Includes all scenes exactly as intended by the artists, featuring mature and explicit content.

  • Digital Artbook Format: Easy-to-view and store image files for your personal use.

  • Direct Developer Support: Your purchase helps fund future projects and updates.

Please Note:

  • This DLC contains uncensored sexual content. It is intended for adults only. The base game is required to access this content.

  • This is a digital art pack. The images are provided as high-resolution PNG/JPG files and are accessed outside of the game through your local files. (Steam\steamapps\common[Your Game Name]\Extras or a similar folder).

Thank you for your incredible support! Enjoy the art.

content_descriptors.notes:
This DLC is a Supporter Pack containing high-resolution digital art. It does not contain gameplay elements. The artwork within this pack depicts mature themes intended for an adult audience.

The content includes:

Nudity and Sexual Content: The pack contains explicit artwork depicting nudity and sexual acts. This content is not censored.

Violence: The artwork features graphic depictions of violence, including blood, gore, and intense scenes of a violent nature.

Potential Sensitive Topics:
While primarily artistic in nature, some images may contain themes that players may have a sensitivity to, including depictions of:

Sexual violence/non-consensual sex.

Drug and alcohol abuse.

Psychological horror and intense situations.

This content is recommended only for adults aged 18 and over. Player discretion is strongly advised.
